args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in all regions.

trace.final:
I've completed the task:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

2. **Identified the rollback target**: The deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent version that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

3. **Rolled back**: Deployed `v2.3.0` to all production regions — verified successful in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) for `checkout-api`, describing the health-check failure and the rollback action taken. The on-call engineer has been paged.
